bodyText.heading: Intensive German courses and modular courses in Heidelberg
bodyText.text: Whether you want to reach a new language level quickly, prepare specifically for an exam, or improve your German skills for study or work – at Academy of Languages you’ll find the right course format. Our German courses range from intensive courses for rapid progress to flexible modular courses designed to help you deepen your language skills at your own pace. All courses are based on the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) and are suitable for levels A1 to C1.

bodyText.heading: MODULAR COURSES – GREATER LEARNING SUCCESS THROUGH TARGETED TRAINING
bodyText.text: Our modular courses are the perfect supplement to the intensive German course in the mornings and offer you the opportunity to specifically work on the language areas you wish to improve. This allows you to deepen your German language skills efficiently and achieve your learning goals faster. Clear learning objectives to build upon and complement the morning course Targeted compensation of deficits at the current language level ✓ Training of all language skills appropriate to the respective level ✓ Structured preparation for internal exams ✓ Small groups with individual support ✓ Stress-free communication and active language training

bodyText.heading: German courses in Heidelberg for every language level
bodyText.text: We offer our intensive German course in Heidelberg at all levels from A1 to C1, in accordance with the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). You can easily find out which level is right for you with our free placement test.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German A1 course in Heidelberg
bodyText.text: Are you a beginner and want to learn the basics of the German language quickly? Our German A1 intensive course will teach you how to speak, listen, read and write step by step - perfect for your start in Germany.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German A2 course in Heidelberg
bodyText.text: Do you already have some basic knowledge? In the German A2 course you will improve your grammar and vocabulary so that you can move more confidently in everyday life and in simple conversations.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German B1 course in Heidelberg
bodyText.text: This course is ideal if you are preparing for university, an internship or everyday life in Germany. With the German B1 intensive course, you will practise speaking freely, understanding texts and writing your first longer texts.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German B2 Heidelberg
bodyText.text: This course is ideal if you want to improve your German language skills to an advanced level and prepare yourself specifically for studying, working or everyday life in Germany. With the German B2 intensive course, you will practise speaking fluently, complex text comprehension and writing more demanding texts.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German C1 course in Heidelberg
bodyText.text: This course is aimed at anyone who wants to perfect their language skills - e.g. for university entrance, a job or an official language certificate. In the C1 Intensive German course, you will work at an almost native speaker level.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German C2 course
bodyText.text: C2 courses are available on request. Feel free to contact us for advice without obligation!

bodyText.heading: Not sure whether A1, A2 or B1?
bodyText.text: Find out your language level quickly and easily - from A1 to C2. Our German placement test helps you to find the right course for your individual learning needs. You will receive immediate feedback on your current language level so that you can start your intensive course in a targeted manner. Take our free German placement test now!

bodyText.heading: German intensive courses in Heidelberg
bodyText.text: Every year, more than 10,000 language learners and exam candidates from over 100 countries put their trust in Academy of Languages. Learn German in Heidelberg in an international environment and benefit from professional German courses at levels A1–C1 at a well-established language school in Heidelberg. Our intensive courses will help you achieve your language goals more quickly and successfully.

bodyText.heading: Excellent language school in Heidelberg - certified intensive German courses
bodyText.text: As part of the renowned Academy of Languages Our language school in Heidelberg stands for the highest quality, modern teaching methods, and measurable learning success. Our German intensive courses from A1 to C1 are multiple certified and are based on the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). As well as satisfying thousands of learners from around the world, we have been recognised with various awards and accreditations over the years - a testament to our ongoing commitment to combining effective teaching with enjoyment and structure. Whether you are learning German for work, study or everyday life - with us you benefit from a learning environment that not only motivates you, but also has a lasting effect.

bodyText.heading: Excellent language school in Heidelberg
bodyText.text: Academy of Languages is synonymous with quality: we have received the ST Star Award, the iStudy Award and the Excellence Award on several occasions.

bodyText.text: With an intensive German course at Academy of Languages, you’ll benefit from an effective learning method, personalised support and an international learning environment. Our German courses (A1–C1) will help you achieve your language goals for study, work or everyday life in Germany more quickly.

✓ Rapid learning progress through intensive training ✓ German courses A1–C1 according to CEFR ✓ Small groups and personal attention ✓ Flexible course models for your goals ✓ International Language School in Heidelberg

bodyText.heading: 1. take a free placement test
bodyText.text: To ensure that you start at the right level (e.g. A1, A2, B1, B2 or C1), take our short placement test online or on site. This will ensure that the course is perfectly suited to your language level.

bodyText.heading: 2. select course and start date
bodyText.text: Choose your suitable course start: Our intensive courses start regularly, mostly on Mondays. You can join at any time on a Monday.

bodyText.heading: 3. register online or reserve a place
bodyText.text: Use our registration form or contact us directly to secure your place. Registration is non-binding - we will be happy to answer any questions you may have.

bodyText.heading: 4. learn German with success and fun!
bodyText.text: Once you have successfully registered, you will receive all the information about the course programme. Then it's time to learn German in Heidelberg - intensively, interactively and successfully!

bodyText.heading: Are intensive German courses worthwhile?
bodyText.text: A German intensive course is particularly worthwhile if you want to learn German quickly and effectively. With daily lessons lasting several hours, you can significantly improve your language skills in a short space of time - whether for work, study or everyday life in Germany. Intensive courses also offer small groups and qualified teachers who provide you with individualised support. This allows you to achieve your learning goals quickly and sustainably.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German course in Heidelberg for children
bodyText.text: Children also benefit from special German intensive courses in Heidelberg. Our child-friendly learning programmes promote listening comprehension, speaking and reading in a playful way. This enables young learners to quickly make connections at school and in their free time. The courses are age-appropriate and help children to feel confident in their new environment and to cope well linguistically.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German course in Heidelberg for foreigners
bodyText.text: For foreigners Intensive German course in Heidelberg ideal for rapid linguistic integration. Our courses cover all levels from A1 to C1 and are specially tailored to the needs of learners from abroad. Our free placement test will help you find the perfect course to improve your German language skills in a targeted manner.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German course in Heidelberg for the visa
bodyText.text: If you would like to apply for a visa for Germany, you will often need proof of German language skills. Our German intensive courses in Heidelberg meet the requirements of many visa programmes. With a certificate of attendance at the end of the course, you can officially prove your language competence - an important requirement for your visa.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German course in Heidelberg for work and study
bodyText.text: For working people and students, our German intensive courses in Heidelberg the perfect preparation. The courses provide practical training in all relevant language skills and promote specialised vocabulary. This means you are ideally equipped for everyday working life or studying at a German university.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German course in Heidelberg for Ukrainians
bodyText.text: Especially for refugees and new arrivals from Ukraine, we offer customised German intensive courses in Heidelberg courses. These courses provide special support for the rapid acquisition of the German language in order to facilitate integration, career entry and social participation.

bodyText.text: Our prices for the Intensive German course in Heidelberg are transparent and staggered according to course duration: Intensive course 20 (Monday - Friday 9:00 - 12:15): 215 EUR/week (1-6 weeks), 190 EUR/week (7-16 weeks), 165 EUR/week (17-29 weeks), 150 EUR/week (from 30 weeks) Intensive course 30 (Monday - Friday 9:00 - 14:30): 270 EUR/week (1-6 weeks), 245 EUR/week (7-16 weeks), 220 EUR/week (17-29 weeks), 205 EUR/week (from 30 weeks) Superintensive course 35 (Monday - Friday 9:00 - 14:30): 435 EUR/week (1-6 weeks), 410 EUR/week (7-16 weeks), 385 EUR/week (17-29 weeks). Private lessons by arrangement.

bodyText.heading: Intensive German courses nearby
bodyText.text: Our language school in Heidelberg is centrally located and easy to reach - ideal if you are looking for a Intensive German course nearby search. Travelling by public transport is also uncomplicated. We also offer online intensive courses for those who want to stay flexible.

bodyText.heading: Support options for the intensive German course
bodyText.text: Many of our intensive German courses can be supported by various funding programmes, for example by employment agencies or education grants. You can often receive financial help for your course in Heidelberg. Please contact us to discuss individual funding options.

bodyText.heading: German intensive course like at the adult education centre (VHS)
bodyText.text: Our intensive German courses in Heidelberg offer you the same high quality as at the adult education centre (VHS), but with even more flexibility and individual support. Benefit from small learning groups, modern teaching methods and personal counselling - for your rapid learning success.

bodyText.heading: German intensive course with certificate
bodyText.text: At the end of your course, you will receive an official certificate of attendance documenting your language skills at the appropriate level (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1). This certificate is important for job applications, studies and work and is recognised by many institutions.

bodyText.heading: German intensive course A1 - The perfect start
bodyText.text: For beginners we offer the German intensive course A1 in Heidelberg. Here you will learn the basics of the German language so that you can find your way around in everyday life. The course is ideal for anyone who wants to start without prior knowledge and achieve initial success quickly.

bodyText.heading: Exam preparation
bodyText.text: Prepare specifically for important language examinations such as TOEFL, IELTS, TestDaF or telc. Our specialised courses will give you the knowledge and confidence you need to succeed in the exam.

bodyText.heading: Language tests
bodyText.text: We offer certified language examinations. Whether TestDaF, onSET or TOEFL. Find out more about dates for 2025 here.

bodyText.text: Improve your English skills - on site in Heidelberg or conveniently online. Our courses are practice-orientated and suitable for all levels so that you can achieve your language goals quickly.

bodyText.heading: Online German courses
bodyText.text: Learn German flexibly, effectively and from anywhere - with our professional online German courses. Ideal if you don't have time for face-to-face courses but don't want to compromise on quality.
